subject: gk
question:
Which of the following pairs of "term-sports" is correct?

I. Eagle - Hockey

II. Penalty kick - Volleyball
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 2**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Neither of the pairs is correct.
 
• ** Eagle** is not a term used in **hockey**. Hockey uses terms such as forward, defenseman,** goal, power play, penalty kill, etc.**
 
• **Penalty kick** is not a term used in volleyball. Volleyball uses terms such as serve, **spike, block, dig, set, rotation, etc.**
 
• **A penalty kick** is a term used in** soccer,** where it refers to a free kick taken from the penalty spot after a foul has been committed inside the penalty area.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some important terms related to sports are listed here-
 
 
• **Football:** Corner kick, direct free kick, indirect free kick, dribble, goal kick, penalty, hat triick, off side, tripping etc.
 
• **Volleyboll:** Blocking, Doubling, heave, holding, love service, volley
 
• **Basket ball:** Ball, basket, blocking, dribbling, free throw, held ball, holding, jump ball, multiple throws, pivot, etc.
 
• **Hockey:** Bully, carry, corner, dribble, hat trick, off-side, scoop, short corner, long corner, penalty stroke, etc.
 
• **Cricket:** Power-play, boundary, bowling, wicket, l.b.w, leg-bye, maiden over, no ball, off break, out, over, pitch, run out, sixer, straight drive, stumped, yorker etc.
 
• **Tennis:** Ace, Backhand, Stroke, deuce, deep volley, double fault, fault, ground stroke, half volley, let, lov, slice, smash, volley etc.
 
• **Table tennis:** Anti loop, Backspin, chop, loop, penhold grip, twiddle etc.
